title: Portuguese Fish Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Portugal, featuring fish as the main ingredient. This recipe is easy to make and perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the Portuguese broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the fish pieces to the pot and cook until they start to flake apart, about 5 minutes.
Add the luminous (if using) and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or lemon wedges if desired.
